definition: A standardized dataset and evaluation protocol used to measure and compare the performance of different models on a specific task or set of tasks.
details: Benchmarks like GLUE, MMLU, and HumanEval provide common yardsticks for tracking progress in NLP and LLM capabilities, though over-optimization to specific benchmarks (benchmark overfitting) is a recognized concern.
story: Think of a referee whose job is to be completely honest about who touched the ball last. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. What gets measured is what actually gets better. That shared ruler is Benchmark.
